title: Iran, Oil, Canada & U.S. Trade Tensions
description:
The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are RBC Capital Markets Head of Derivatives Strategy Amy Wu Silverman, Canada Chamber of Commerce Principal Economist Andrew DiCapua, Guggenheim Senior Analyst, Retail & E-Commerce Simeon Siegel, Marquee Brands CEO Heath Golden, Westwood Holdings Group CEO Brian Casey, AllianceBernstein Head of Equities Nelson Yu, BIVA CEO Maria Ariza, Panama Canal Administrator Ilya Espino de Marotta, Qualcomm CFO Akash Palkhiwala, Cisco President & Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel, & Kroll CEO Jacob Silverman.
